title: Executive Assistant
why_it_fits: Executive Assistant match. 2 skills: google workspace, excel. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
NeoWork is hiring Executive Assistants to provide high-level support to founders and executives at fast-growing U.S. companies. You will keep your executive's day running smoothly, so they can focus on growing the business.

NeoWork is a global staffing and operations partner that builds dedicated remote teams for fast-growing U.S. companies. Our teammates work directly inside our clients' teams and tools, while NeoWork takes care of recruiting, HR, benefits, and ongoing support.
key_responsibilities:
Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination across time zones
Own inbox management, drafting and prioritizing correspondence on the executive's behalf
Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries, and expense reports
Prepare reports, presentations, and meeting notes
Track priorities, deadlines, and follow-ups across projects and teams
Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism

3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar role
Excellent spoken and written English
Outstanding organization and time management skills
Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft 365
Ability to anticipate needs and work independently with minimal direction
Availability to work U.S. business hours
Based in the Philippines, with a reliable home office setup and stable internet connection

Nice to Have
Experience supporting C-level executives or founders
Experience with project management tools such as Asana, ClickUp, or Notion

Health Maintenance Organization (HMO)
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Mental Health Leave
Birthday Leave
Gym Allowance
Extra Holiday Pay
Remote Work Setup
Opportunities for professional growth and development
